experiment: V42 premature-alarm repair by calibration sample size and EPC-adjusted limits

commissioning.rationale: input_calibration and local_healthy_fitting stay fixed for every arm; only the score-calibration window (and, for arm D, the absence of any fixed window) varies

frozen_v29b_policy.origin: frozen V29b source policy, copied verbatim from raw_online_federated_v41_protocol.DRAFT.json; strong stays fixed for every V42 arm, only moderate is bootstrap-adjusted by arm C

epc.adjusts: per-branch moderate limit only; strong is never adjusted

eligibility.rule: stream length must exceed (input_calibration + local_healthy_fitting + calibration_points + heldout_guard) so at least one post-commissioning operational acquisition exists; self_starting uses (local_healthy_fitting_end + heldout_guard) in place of calibration_points

gate.failure_action: write the complete report, all tables, and all figures, then exit 2

G2_erratum.note: G2 was originally defined as a LATCH-based guard false-alarm rate. That definition is withdrawn: guard_length=4 < persistence_window=7 means the 4-of-7 condition can never be evaluated within the guard at all, so a latch-based guard rate is arithmetically forced to 0% for every arm and calibration size, not measured. V41R1's own 'guard was already clean' finding (and V19's XJTU 0-guard/10-of-12 split) were the same vacuous arithmetic, not validated safety. G2 is redefined as the per-acquisition exceedance rate within the guard (fraction of guard acquisitions where the pre-persistence ensemble condition is met), which CAN vary with calibration size and limit rule. The latch-based figure is still computed and reported, explicitly labelled structurally zero with the window arithmetic shown, so it is never again cited as evidence. G4 (device-level false-alarm rate on full control records) is therefore the load-bearing specificity gate, not G2.
G2_erratum.structural_check: audit phase asserts guard_length >= persistence_window and records latch_based_guard_metrics_vacuous in v42_audit_lock.json; fails loudly (prints a warning) rather than silently emitting a zero rate

secondary_endpoint_caveat: premature/valid/late/missed against the analytical onset reference is proxy-dependent; the premature fraction moves from 23% to 97% purely with the commissioning rule (memory.txt Appendix 2026-07-27B) and every table carrying these labels must repeat this caveat
